# Copilot Instructions

This repository is a personal collection of notes on drug discovery online courses.

## Structure

- `mcbdd-2026/` — Notes for the MCBDD (Methods in Computational Biology and Drug Discovery) 2026 course
- Notes are written in Markdown

## Conventions

- Each course or topic gets its own subdirectory named with the course identifier and year (e.g., `mcbdd-2026/`)
- Notes are plain Markdown files
